claims.claim: Bleached corals returned to full health in seven weeks after brief contact with healthy clones in a lab setting.
claims.episode_span: Researchers observed white, dying corals return to complete color and function inside a lab after limited exposure to living clones of the same species. The recovery happened in as little as seven weeks, the shortest time yet recorded for such a reversal.
claims.source_title: Scientists discover a way to reverse coral bleaching at record speed
claims.supporting_quote: For the first time, scientists have observed bleached corals on the brink of death fully recover through brief contact with healthy clones. Ghostly white corals returned to full health in a laboratory setting within seven weeks, the fastest documented recovery to date, according to a study published in Science Advances.

claims.claim: The Iberian lynx population rebounded from a low of 62 individuals in 2002 through targeted breeding and habitat work.
claims.episode_span: Conservation teams in Spain and Portugal tracked the species from its 2002 nadir of roughly 62 wild cats to several hundred today through targeted breeding, habitat corridors, and prey restoration.
claims.source_title: From 62 animals to a successful recovery: What can the Balkans learn from saving the Iberian lynx?
claims.supporting_quote: From 62 animals to a successful recovery: What can the Balkans learn from saving the Iberian lynx?

claims.claim: Green turtle nests have tripled in one Malaysian archipelago after fifty years of protection work.
claims.episode_span: Local teams recorded three times as many nests this season compared with counts from fifty years earlier, following consistent beach patrols, egg relocation, and community agreements that reduced egg harvesting.
claims.source_title: Malaysian Archipelago triples the number of green turtle nests: a marine conservation success in 50 years
claims.supporting_quote: Malaysian Archipelago triples the number of green turtle nests: a marine conservation success in 50 years
